title: Prospect row (one line of a targets_*.jsonl file)
description: One prospect row inside the audience covered by a campaign_authorization. Each row must independently satisfy the authorization's audience_definition.inclusion_rule and fail every audience_definition.exclusion_rule; that check is manual/upstream, not enforced by this schema. This schema enforces SHAPE only. render_message.py refuses to render for any row where suppression is true, email is null, or email_verification_status is not "valid".

email.description: MUST be null unless a real address has been obtained through verified enrichment and passed through a verification service. Never a pattern-guessed or constructed address.

email_source.description: Provenance of the email field. "guessed" exists in the enum for completeness but render_message.py's email_verification_status gate makes a guessed/unverified address unsendable regardless.

email_verification_status.description: Result of a third-party verification pass. Must be exactly "valid" for render_message.py to allow a render for this row.

hook_date.description: Date the hook was published, as a plain date string (source-dependent precision, e.g. 2026-06-25).

proof_artifact_url.description: OPTIONAL. Not part of the required prospect-shape fields above. Present so the {{proof_artifact_url}} template variable (in variable_allowlist) has a value to resolve against. In targets_arg_c1.jsonl this is the same public proof-repo URL on every row (a campaign-wide constant carried per-row for render_message.py's simple row-lookup design), not a per-prospect fact.
